response.sql: WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.lunarstage), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) AS mean_phase_average FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.avg_bandwidth) AS average_bandwidth_average, SUM(p.telescope_count) AS total_count, AVG(p.avg_bandwidth - overall.mean_phase_average) AS average_excess FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN overall WHERE p.avg_bandwidth > overall.mean_phase_average
